description: Look up the identity label of an EVM address (Base, open eth-labels dataset; mostly category tags rather than named entities). Returns which entity the address belongs to; unlabelled addresses return null. Call with no arguments for a free demo result.

address.description: 0x-prefixed address. Omit it to run a free demo lookup (USDC contract on Base), e.g. 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913

name: get_label
